response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM manager_award GROUP BY player_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM counts) SELECT c.player_id, c.cnt, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS fraction FROM counts c CROSS JOIN total t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each row in manager_award is one manager award record, so a player's count is COUNT(*) of their rows across all award types, years and leagues, and the total is the sum of those per-player counts.
Players with no manager_award rows are excluded, since they have no records to count and do not contribute to the total.
The fraction is left unrounded and is computed with REAL division so integer division does not truncate it to 0.
